rationale: Correct Boralex from a pro forma pending take-private presentation to the closed ownership structure effective August 14, 2026. Brookfield owns 70% through Brookfield Infrastructure Fund V and BIF Thunder Holdings Inc.; La Caisse owns 30% after continuing and increasing the equity position it began in 2017. Remove the unsupported Brookfield BISS and CDPQ Infrastructure fund attributions, distinguish La Caisse's equity from its separate debt financing, and preserve one global Boralex operating-company record.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Boralex Inc. develops, builds, owns and operates wind, solar, hydroelectric and battery-storage assets across Canada, the United States, France and the United Kingdom. The company reported 3,822 MW of installed capacity and a nearly 8.2 GW development pipeline when its take-private closed on August 14, 2026. Boralex now operates as a private company owned 70% by Brookfield and 30% by La Caisse. Brookfield's interest is held through the Brookfield Infrastructure Fund V acquisition structure and BIF Thunder Holdings Inc., with Brookfield Renewable Partners among the participating partners. La Caisse first acquired 17.3% of Boralex on July 27, 2017, held approximately 15% before the take-private and continued or increased its equity to 30% at closing; no named La Caisse fund is publicly disclosed. A separate 2025 subordinated loan was debt and is not an ownership period. BIF Thunder is an acquisition vehicle rather than a separate PortCo. No later ownership transfer or signed pending sale was identified through August 23, 2026.

Brookfield and La Caisse announced an all-cash agreement to take Boralex private for C$37.25 per share.
Boralex shareholders approved the arrangement and the Québec Superior Court issued its final order.
Brookfield and La Caisse completed the take-private, establishing current ownership at 70% and 30%, respectively.
